description: Keyword search of mail (BM25 over subject, sender and own words), every list unless inbox narrows it. Messages best first (collapse_threads keeps one per thread): inbox, message_id, subject, from, date, thread_id, excerpt; total, has_more. For exact words, names, identifiers; questions: hybrid_search. complete=false: out of budget_ms or total is a lower bound (timed_out, total_partial, total_capped say which). define:<term> also returns definition (as search_docs). Cite https://postgr.es/m/<message_id>.

author.description: Only mail this person sent: name, address or hash:<8 hex>; every address they use. An ambiguous name returns the candidates

collapse_threads.description: One hit per thread, the best (default false)

inbox.description: "all" (default), one list (pgsql-bugs) or several, comma-separated; names from list_inboxes

query.description: Words. Operators: after:/before:YYYY[-MM[-DD]], d:A..B, site:<list|docs|wiki|commits>, from:/author:, intitle:/s:, intext:/b:, to:/cc:, filetype:patch, has:patch, link:<url glob> (link:host = any URL there), /regex/ (case:yes), -operator negates. Operators alone list newest first.

since.description: On or after (UTC): YYYY[-MM[-DD]], ISO date-time, or 2w / 6m / 1y ago

until.description: Before (exclusive), same forms as since. With author: what they had said by then

name: search
